field.name: com_tjucm_lettings_LettingsdefinitionLabel
field.label: Lettings definition Label
field.freetext: A letting is defined as any use of the school building or grounds by parties other than the school/trust. This may be a community group or a commercial organisation.

field.name: com_tjucm_lettings_Hasduediligencebeencompletedonthelettingsorganisation
field.label: Has any due diligence been completed on the lettings organisation?

field.name: com_tjucm_lettings_Dataondisplayorondesksinroomsbeinglethasavebeenreviewed
field.label: Data on display or on desks in rooms being let has been reviewed
field.description: Third parties can be the cause of a cyber attack and data breach

field.name: com_tjucm_lettings_LocationsLabel
field.label: Locations Label
field.freetext:
Consider what locations the letting has access to other than the room(s) designated for their activity.  While the organisation may use one particular location they may need access to other areas such as the kitchen or toilets.  In doing so, what other rooms can they access, such as classrooms or offices? 

Always lock SLT and admin offices out of hours even if all personal data is locked away.  Other members of staff may inadvertently leave private and confidential information on a desk.  Consider what locations could be locked out of hours that the letting does not need access to.

field.name: com_tjucm_lettings_Areemptyofficesandroomslockedduringlettingshours
field.label: Are empty offices and rooms locked during lettings hours?

field.name: com_tjucm_lettings_Hastherebeenareviewofwhatinformationisondisplayonwallsandcorridors
field.label: Has there been a review of what information is on display on walls and corridors?
field.description: Review the use of lists and if they are needed, could they be kept online or in a more secure area?

field.name: com_tjucm_lettings_Doesthelettingorganisationhaveasecurephysicallocationtokeeppaperpersonaldataifrequired
field.label: Does the letting organisation have a secure physical location to keep paper personal data if required?
field.description: Although the letting is likely to be the controller of data collected for the letting, as the activity is held on school premises, there is a responsibility to ensure that data is held in a safe and secure manner when the letting is not present. If paperwork is required, then a lockable storage location may be required for the letting in the school.

field.name: com_tjucm_lettings_HasdeviceandITphysicalsecuritybeenreviewed
field.label: Has device and IT physical security been reviewed?
field.description: For example, if the server is in a public space, such as the staffroom which is not locked, would the lettings have access to it?

field.name: com_tjucm_lettings_Hastherebeenareviewofthesecurityofmobiledevices
field.label: Has there been a review of the security of mobile devices?
field.description: Ensure mobile devices have PIN codes and are locked away out of hours.

field.name: com_tjucm_lettings_HastherebeenareviewofWiFiaccessrequirements
field.label: Has there been a review of Wi-Fi access requirements?
field.description: If access to the organisation's Wi-Fi is required then ensure there is a specific guest network which does not allow access to systems resources.

field.name: com_tjucm_lettings_Schoolstaffaccesslabel
field.label: School staff access label
field.freetext: Some school staff may work for the lettings organisation as well. If they have access to the school's systems, such as the MIS during the day, this does not automatically allow access to systems for the lettings organisation out of school hours. For example, the pupil MIS should not be accessed in order to obtain a parental contact unless there is a specific data sharing agreement in place and the data was collected for that purpose.

field.name: com_tjucm_lettings_Hastheprivacypolicyforthelettingscompanybeenreviewedaspartofanyduediligence
field.label: Has the privacy policy for the lettings company been reviewed as part of any due diligence?

field.name: com_tjucm_lettings_Arestaffregularlyremindedthatlettingsandthirdpartiesareonsiteandthatpersonaldatashouldbesecureandlockedawayoutofhoursandunderstanditistheirresponsibility
field.label: Are staff regularly reminded that lettings and third parties are on site and that personal data should be secure and locked away out of hours and understand it is their responsibility?

field.name: com_tjucm_lettings_Arekeysandaccesscodesreturnedresetwhenthelettingsceases
field.label: Is there a process for keys and access codes to be returned/reset when the letting ceases?

field.name: com_tjucm_lettings_Doestheorganisationhaveaphysicalsecuritypolicywherelettingsproceduresaredocumented
field.label: Does the organisation have a physical security policy where lettings procedures are documented?

field.name: com_tjucm_lettings_AwarenessLabel
field.label: Awareness Label
field.freetext: Regularly review with staff what is displayed in classrooms and public areas.  Review the need for lists and their locations.  Review: DPE Quick Reference Guide

field.name: com_tjucm_lettings_Isyoursitesecureattheendofthedaywhenusedbylettings
field.label: Is your site secure at the end of the day when used by lettings?
field.description: For example, if your school was used by a 'slimming club' and the session started shortly after school finishes, how do you ensure that not just anyone can walk into the school? i.e. are doors left open.

field.name: com_tjucm_lettings_Isthereasigninprocedureforlettings
field.label: Is there a sign in procedure for lettings?
field.description: This is particularly important if the lettings are on site during the school day.
